conditions.cache: source hash warms cache; no cache flush; no warmup excluded
conditions.concurrency: one trial and at most one worker; host otherwise uncontrolled
conditions.order: direct-worker on even repeat; worker-direct on odd repeat
conditions.temporary_storage: TMPDIR set to trial workspace on same filesystem as output
conditions.timing: disk observations overlap conversion timer; worker lifetime includes startup/import/conversion/receipt/exit; publication is a subset of conversion
conditions.unavailable: child-only conversion and child startup split; direct publication split; true temporary disk peak; process-tree RSS peak
